title: Homesite Reservation Agreement — Buyer Release and Refund Clause
content:
**1. How a reservation is released.** A buyer ends a Homesite Reservation only by signing the written release. The release date is the date the signed release is received.

**2. Reservation deposit.** On release, the reservation deposit is refunded in full.

**3. The full-refund window.** The clause "a release is inside the full-refund window when the signed release is received within the class's full-refund window days after the reservation date", and the clause "days are counted from the day after the reservation date, and a release received on the last counted day is inside the window", are both **no longer in force**; they have been superseded by the current basis for the full-refund window.

**4. Premium holding fee.** Inside the window the premium holding fee is refunded where the class refunds the premium holding fee on a release inside the window. The clause "after the window the class's after-window percent of the premium holding fee is refunded (rounded half up to the cent) and the rest is retained" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the premium holding fee release refund.

**5. Fees.** Extension, swap, reinstatement and returned-payment fees and card convenience fees are never refunded on a release and are retained.

**6. Issuing refunds.** Refunds are issued by the class's refund method within the class's refund processing business days after the release date, one refund per source payment and component, each pointing to the receipt number of the payment it returns.

**7. Builder withdrawal.** Funds on a hold that Calloway withdraws from sale are handled under the builder withdrawal terms instead of this clause.

## Basis questions

**Does the buyer's phone call end the reservation?** Clause 1 states that a reservation is ended only by the signed written release, and the release date is the date that signed release is received.

**Is a card convenience fee paid on the reservation returned on release?** No; under clause 5 it is retained, as are extension, swap, reinstatement and returned-payment fees.

**How many refund entries does a release produce?** One per source payment and component, each carrying the receipt number of the payment it returns.
